sentences.text: Siobhan Kelly is the district nurse who has been seeing Keith Dawson for leg ulcers.
Keith Dawson has leg ulcers on both legs that are slow to heal.
Keith Dawson's GP is Dr Morgan at Holloway surgery.
Keith Dawson's wife left in 2015.
Keith Dawson's brother Phil lives in Northby and they talk at Christmas.
Keith Dawson receives Employment and Support Allowance (ESA) and is waiting for a pension next year.
Keith Dawson believes he is up to date with bills, though the gas is on a meter.
Keith Dawson has not had heating since October.
Keith Dawson has not had hot water since October.
Keith Dawson uses a fan heater but does not use it regularly due to high cost.
Keith Dawson has not washed in three to four weeks.
Keith Dawson has not cooked meals in the kitchen due to rats.
Keith Dawson has seen two rats in the kitchen in the last few weeks, which have been feeding on bread.
Keith Dawson has been eating soup and beans from tins, and relies on carers for meals.
Keith Dawson has a home care package with Bright Days, scheduled for morning and teatime visits.
In the last two weeks, Bright Days should have made 28 visits but missed 16.
For four days last week, no Bright Days carers came to Keith Dawson’s home.
Keith Dawson did not contact Bright Days when carers failed to arrive and did not want to cause bother.
Keith Dawson's main wishes are for the heating to be fixed and the rats to be removed.
Keith Dawson does not want to move into a home or any residential setting.
A neighbour at number 25 reported to the district nurse that Keith Dawson has been drinking heavily.
The district nurse did not observe any signs of heavy drinking in Keith Dawson.
Keith Dawson denies any issues with drinking and calls the neighbour a 'nosy cow'.
The social worker, Rachel Burns, will raise a safeguarding concern about missed care visits and the condition of the home.
Keith Dawson agrees to the safeguarding concern being raised if the boiler is fixed.
The district nurse will continue to visit Keith Dawson on Tuesdays and Fridays for leg ulcers.
The social worker will contact the housing association to log the boiler as an emergency repair.
The social worker will request two oil heaters to be delivered to the home within the next 24 hours.
The social worker will contact environmental health to arrange pest control in the kitchen.
The social worker will raise the issue of missed care visits with Bright Days and the commissioning team.
